I'm a Master of Business Analytics student at Monash University. Before moving to Melbourne, I studied Information Technology engineering in Mumbai, where I got into web development and data science projects.

I like turning messy data into something people can actually use to make a decision. I'm also curious about entrepreneurship, so I enjoy work where analysis connects to real business questions.

This site is where I share my data stories for ETC5523 Communicating with Data.
